mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_review_delivery (delivery_key, bot_id, post_id, content_version, chat_id, message_id, status, expires_at, callback_id, approved, reviewer, decided_at, decision_status) VALUES (#{id}, #{botId}, #{postId}, #{version}, #{chatId}, #{messageId}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{callbackId}, #{approved}, #{reviewer}, #{decidedAt}, #{decisionStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weibo_review_delivery WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND delivery_key = #{id}
SELECT * FROM weibo_review_delivery WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND content_version = #{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE weibo_review_delivery SET status = 'SENT', message_id = #{messageId} WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND delivery_key = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE weibo_review_delivery SET status = 'UNKNOWN' WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND delivery_key = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE weibo_review_delivery SET callback_id = #{callbackId}, approved = #{approved}, reviewer = #{reviewer}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, decision_status = 'PENDING' WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND delivery_key = #{id} AND status = 'SENT' AND callback_id IS NULL
UPDATE weibo_review_delivery SET decision_status = #{decisionStatus} WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND delivery_key = #{id} AND decision_status = 'PENDING' AND callback_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_review_polling (bot_id, next_offset) VALUES (#{botId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bot_id = bot_id
mapper.update: UPDATE weibo_review_polling SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{until} WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT next_offset FROM weibo_review_polling WHERE bot_id = #{botId}
mapper.update: UPDATE weibo_review_polling SET lease_until = #{until} WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until > #{now}
UPDATE weibo_review_polling SET lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND lease_owner = #{owner}
